status: Proposed operational rubric; not official ICML grades and not yet human-calibrated.
unit: paper-level central contribution, with separate claim-level records

novelty_levels.L0: 在明确可比的假设、任务、信息与成本模型下，中心新意已被前作覆盖；必须有正面的覆盖或等价证据，不能仅因没看懂或未查到而判零。
novelty_levels.L1: 可靠但局部的参数、模块或场景改进；未展示新的核心机制、重要限制解除或可迁移认识。仍可能有应用价值。
novelty_levels.L2: 有明确的新知识、机制理解、能力或保证；可通过非显然组合、理论、评测或系统工作获得，不要求从零发明框架。
novelty_levels.L3: 路线级增量候选：提出原先缺少的核心问题、机制、理论框架或研究接口。只是当前可审计判断，不宣称已获历史证明。
novelty_levels.U: 关键前作、推导、实验、版本或分类边界未核实，暂不裁决。

anti_shortcuts: semantic distance is retrieval evidence, not novelty
citation counts and descendants are not originality
code diff size and equation length are not originality
combination and substantive novelty can overlap
identical mathematical outputs can coexist with a novel lower-cost implementation
an unsupported novel idea is not automatically an old idea; soundness is separate
absence of known parents is not proof of founding a field
the proposed rubric must be calibrated and frozen before confirmatory estimation
